newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: TransAlta's EDL reports last result.
newsitem.headline: TransAlta's EDL reports last result.

text.p: EnergyDirect Corp Ltd, now part of TransAlta New Zealand Ltd, recorded a net profit of NZ$10.5 million for the six months to September 30, down from $11.5 million a year ago, TransAlta NZ said on Tuesday.
On an operating level the profit was NZ$12.2 million from $11.5 million, TransAlta said.
EnergyDirect and Capital Power merged on October 1 to form TransAlta NZ, and the result was the last to be reported by EnergyDirect.
EnergyDirect's sales for the six months were NZ$88.7 million, against $88.5 million a year ago.
The increase in operating earnings came mostly from reduced operating expenses resulting from the restructuring.
Transalta NZ Chairman Ron Arbuckle said the profit was satisfactory and in line with expectations.
The NZ$10.5 million net profit reflected $1.7 million of costs associated with the restructuring and the successful merger with Capital Power, he said.
